name: jobs-sync-for-zoho-recruit
description: Build tooling for the Jobs Sync for Zoho Recruit block editor assets.

scripts.build: npm run build:jobs && npm run build:job-meta && npm run build:apply-button
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js blocks/jobs/src blocks/job-meta/src blocks/apply-button/src admin/assets/js public/js
scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/jobs-sync-for-zoho-recruit wp i18n make-pot . languages/jobs-sync-for-zoho-recruit.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,bin,dist,.wordpress-org
scripts.makejson: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/jobs-sync-for-zoho-recruit wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
